To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the number of clinical psychologists in medical settings has increased dramatically in the last decade and is likely to continue to grow; (b) the services provided by psychologists in medical settings are diverse and include assessment, intervention, consultation, and training; (c) psychologists in medical settings have been able to demonstrate cost savings in the provision of medical care and are able to demonstrate that their services are effective in the treatment of medical conditions and in enhancing the quality of life of patients; (d)
clinical psychology is making a difference in health care.
clinical psychology in medical care is a growing field of practice and training that is poised for continued growth.

clinical psychologists have made significant contributions to the health care system and have a bright future in medical settings.
the role of clinical psychology in health care has never been stronger or more important.
